doc_title: APPLICATION FOR RECTIFICATION OF REGISTER PURSUANT TO A COURT ORDER
doc_title_official: APPLICATION FOR RECTIFICATION OF REGISTER PURSUANT TO A COURT ORDER
when_used: An applicant lodges a court order for registration so that the register of a title is rectified in the manner the order sets out, attaching a certified true copy of the order.

body_text.text: The Applicant HEREBY APPLIES to the Land Registrar for the registration of the above mentioned Court Order for the rectification of the Register of the above named Land in the manner set out in the Order.
In support of this Application the Applicant attaches a Certified True copy of the Court Order.

custom_fields.name: order_date
custom_fields.label: Date of the Court Order
custom_fields.prompt: The date of the court order to be registered
